sentences.text: The policy mentions credit cards and penal charges, if any, in case of delayed payment, but it does not state any specific late payment fee amount in the provided materials.
For UCBs, credit card receivables are exempted from the APR-disclosure provisions quoted here.

missing.searched: Searched the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions and the credit-card charge tables for a stated late payment fee amount; the provided evidence only shows credit cards and delayed-payment penal charges, not the fee amount.
